instruction:
Using the provided summary, generate a user identity who would likely interact with or benefit from the content — the kind of person who comes looking for this sort of document. Describe who they are.
- name MUST be an identity label (an occupation, job title or user type, e.g. "Digital Marketing Specialist", "Retail Investor", "Industry Analyst"). Do NOT use a personal name (e.g. "John Smith", "Alice"): these questions are put to a retrieval system by a user, and nobody is addressed by name.
- role_description is one sentence saying what this identity cares about and what they would ask about.
- name and role_description must be in the same language as the provided summary.

input.text: Guide to Digital Marketing explains strategies for engaging audiences across various online platforms.

output.name: Digital Marketing Specialist
output.role_description: Focuses on engaging audiences and growing the brand online.
